classification.rationale: Men's knit pullover falls in heading 6110. Under Section XI note 2 the garment is treated as the predominant fiber; hemp (named first) is assumed predominant, giving 6110.90 other textile materials, men's sweaters, other (845). No ruling on hemp/cotton pullovers was found; cotton-only pullover rulings do not apply.
